packageRules.description: Batch every non-major update (npm, docker, github-actions) into a single PR so we never see more than one routine dependency PR at a time.
CLI @pome-sh/* pins are release-gated (lint:cli-pins / changesets). Renovate must not bump them from npm.
Known-risky majors — keep on current major until an intentional human PR.

DO NOT bump actions/setup-node to v7 in sdk-publish.yml — v7 changed how registry-url writes .npmrc and breaks OIDC Trusted Publishing (ENEEDAUTH). The publish job stays on v6.x. See sdk-publish.yml and actions/setup-node#1551. Other workflows may already be on v7.
